title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot in Forms for US Government clouds
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and the government-cloud data-boundary statements match Microsoft Learn. Independent searches did not establish government-specific licensing, an arrival default or a separate Copilot in Forms switch. Three descriptive claims need citations to the additional Microsoft pages that support them.

claims.quote: Copilot in Forms is being enabled for Microsoft Forms in Government Cloud environments

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access is an existing Forms access control using the Forms cloud app.

claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot in Forms" "government" "send"; Microsoft Forms Copilot Insights responses Draft references sending invitations confirmation. Read roadmap and Forms release notes; neither states government-cloud sending approval behaviour.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and api; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate tenant Copilot in Forms availability switch or its automation is documented at November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Forms" "Copilot" "disable" "admin"; "Copilot in Forms" "Graph" "settings"; Microsoft Forms Copilot default enabled automatically disable tenant admin Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Opened Forms admin settings/setup and Copilot overview; no separate Copilot UI/API found.

claims.claim: The existing Forms Conditional Access and Forms administrator-settings documentation does not name Copilot in Forms.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot in the complete Forms setup and administrator-settings pages opened this run. Neither names Copilot; Forms-wide sign-in and licensing controls are documented, but not a separate Copilot control.

claims.claim: Microsoft Forms has external-sharing administrator settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Microsoft Forms has administrator settings for recording names in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: On the Microsoft Forms pane, the Record names by default setting under Record names of people in your org is checked by default.

claims.claim: Microsoft Forms has phishing-protection administrator settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.quote: On the Microsoft Forms pane, the Include Bing search, YouTube videos setting under Allow YouTube and Bing is checked by default.

claims.claim: The Forms administrator-settings page states that those settings are available only for Office 365 Education and Microsoft 365 Apps for business customers.
claims.quote: Administrator settings are only available for Office 365 Education and Microsoft 365 Apps for business customers.

claims.claim: A Microsoft Q&A answer says Forms has no user-facing option to disable Copilot suggestions during form creation.
claims.quote: At this time, there is no user-facing option available in Microsoft Forms to disable Copilot suggestions during form creation.

claims.quote: As a forum moderator, I hope you understand that I don’t have the ability to modify or escalate product issues directly.
